newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-STRUGGLING SOUTHAMPTON SIGN NORWEGIAN STRIKER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRUGGLING SOUTHAMPTON SIGN NORWEGIAN STRIKER.

text.p: Struggling English premier league side Southampton signed Norwegian international striker Egil Ostenstadt from Viking Stavanger on Monday for 900,000 pounds ($1.40 million).
The 24-year-old has scored four goals in four matches for his country and 23 in 24 matches for his club.
"He is a big strong lad with a great goalscoring record and could be just what we need up front," Southampton manager Graeme Souness said.
Souness is also expected to finalise a 1.2 million pound ($1.87 million) deal to bring Israeli international midfielder Eyal Berkowitz from Maccabi Haifa once his work permit is confirmed.
Southampton, who escaped relegation on the final day of last season, are currently third from bottom in the table.
They hope to name both Ostenstadt and Berkowitz in their side to face fellow strugglers Coventry in two weeks time.
